# JSB Manual Binding Rule

## Core Rule

If a SWIG-generated binding needs **any manual modification** to compile or run correctly, it MUST be:

1. Marked as `%ignore` in the `.i` file (e.g., `swig-config/agora_rtc_engine_bridge.i`)
2. Hand-written in `native/bindings/manual/jsb_agora_rtc_manual.cpp`

**NEVER modify the auto-generated files under `native/bindings/auto/`.** These files are regenerated by SWIG on every run and all changes will be lost.

## When to use `%ignore` + manual binding

- Same-argc overloaded functions (SWIG cannot disambiguate)
- Functions that take `se::Object*` parameters (callback registration)
- Functions that return `shared_ptr<Bridge>` objects (need special wrapping)
- Functions that require custom type conversion logic
- Functions where the auto-generated code has compilation errors
- Any function where the generated binding doesn't behave correctly at runtime

## Workflow

1. Add `%ignore ClassName::functionName;` to the `.i` file
2. Write the binding function in `jsb_agora_rtc_manual.cpp`
3. Register it in `register_agora_rtc_manual()`
4. Run `node scripts/genbindings.js /path/to/cocos-engine` to regenerate
5. The ignored function will be excluded from auto-generation
